policy.positive: At least one current institutional affiliation located in India.
policy.negative: All identified current affiliations are outside India.
policy.ambiguous: Insufficient institutional/location evidence, conflicting or unresolved acronym; no established Indian affiliation.
policy.ignore: Names, nationality, email addresses, former affiliations, and India as a research subject are not current affiliation evidence.
policy.overseas_campuses: Classify by campus location rather than parent institution country.

affiliation.instructions: Classify current institutional affiliation by campus location. Ignore author nationality, emails, former jobs and India as a research subject. Bare colliding acronyms or missing locations are ambiguous. Overseas campuses are non-Indian. At least one current Indian affiliation makes the result positive.

criteria.positive: At least one current institutional affiliation is located in India.
criteria.negative: Current institutional affiliations are identified and all are outside India.
criteria.ambiguous: Insufficient evidence to determine current institution or location, and no established Indian affiliation.

paper_level.scope: Replay of structured affiliation decisions and positive-only inclusion, not scraping or LLM extraction.
